Standout restaurant and cafe with a purpose
Oct 2026 • Family
We loved our time at KOTO. It is opposite the Temple of Literature, the interior is comfortable and relaxing. 

The food was some of the best we’ve had in Vietnam. We had the Crispy Fish Roll in wild betel leaves, and the crab and corn soup and chicken and mushroom soup. All were tasty!! The cakes were also divine - lemon cheesecake and an opera layered cake. Excellent coffee.

The staff were so attentive and friendly, and efficient. Cha in particular took great care of us. 

We also loved reading the story behind the social enterprise which appears to be an organisation with very clear values and strong governance. Staff describe the founder Jimmy Pham as being like a big brother.

Free wifi. Gifts from other social enterprises available for purchase. 

We would highly recommend this place as a haven with delicious food.

So great, went twice in 3 days!
Oct 2026 • Couples
Firstly, we had a group set lunch with Intrepid who introduced us to the community support concept. It was so perfect, that we went back as a couple on our last day. My husband loved the ribs. I tried a variety of seafood salads and a beautiful crispy selection of spring rolls and dumplings. 
Our guide Minh Ha explained how the restaurant trains young people from rural areas or disadvantaged backgrounds which is hugely inspiring. 
All the staff were fantastic, so attentive and professional. On our last day, Sau K48 looked after us with great care and attention. He would not be out of place in any high end restaurant! Thanks Sau!
The location is on a beautiful street facing an ancient education centre which we also visited. The upstairs dining room is gorgeous with arched French doors facing the historical buildings. We cannot recommend Koto enough. Hank you.
Read more
Written October 9, 2026
KOTO Van Mieu
Dear F8230ERdonnam, 
Reading your review truly touched us. That you came back for a second time on your last day is one of the loveliest compliments a restaurant can receive. It was a joy to know that the story behind KOTO stayed with you, and that our young team made you feel so welcome.

Your kind words about Sau will mean the world to him, and we’ll be sure he reads them, along with Minh Ha. Moments like this remind us why we do what we do. We hope Hanoi brings you both back to us one day.

Warm regards,
KOTO Van Mieu Team 💚

★★★★★ Amazing food, unique dishes
Sep 2026 • Family
Had a fantastic meal at KOTO Hanoi every dish was packed with flavor and beautifully presented. The betel leaf prawn was a highlight: fresh prawns with crispy shallots, herbs, edible flowers and shaved carrot, so unique and full of texture. For dessert, the caramelized banana flambé with ice cream was warm, rich, and perfectly balanced.

Beyond the food, KOTO is a social enterprise training disadvantaged youth in hospitality, so you're supporting a great cause while enjoying a great meal. Highly recommend to anyone visiting Hanoi!
